scope: Neo Wolf Fang Fist P1 evidence enrichment

Independent Dragon Ball reference identifies the Xenoverse 2 move as a Yamcha Super Skill obtained through PQ86.
Repository's maintained PQ research corpus already uses PQ86 as the acquisition endpoint.
Contemporaneous player testing documents variable Ki consumption as the input is held, corroborating the variable-cost model without replacing the canonical 100–700 range.

resolved_fields.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 86 — Yamcha is Number One

changes: Strengthens the existing research record with current Xenoverse 2-specific variable Ki-cost evidence.
Preserves PQ86 acquisition and does not infer an Ultimate Finish-only gate or exact drop probability.
